2026_03_TEN_NYG.headline: Ward’s ball security meets a Giants offense resetting around Winston in the rain
2026_03_TEN_NYG.paragraph1: Tennessee’s Cam Ward has protected the football through two games, but the Titans need steadier early-down production to keep New York from dictating obvious pressure situations. The Giants turn to Jameis Winston after Jaxson Dart’s season-ending knee injury, with Malik Nabers available as the offense’s primary separator. Tony Pollard’s return to full practice helps Tennessee, while New York’s Brian Burns and Andrew Thomas have carried injury concerns into a matchup expected to feature heavy rain at MetLife Stadium.
2026_03_TEN_NYG.model_rationale: Tennessee’s path depends on staying efficient enough to protect Ward, while New York must stabilize its quarterback transition and avoid allowing weather and negative plays to compress the offense.
